description: Run a compliance evaluation against a live MCP server over Streamable HTTP, the way a client meets it. Checks: initialize (protocol version, serverInfo, Mcp-Session-Id carried afterwards), notifications/initialized (202), tools/list with pagination, the spec's tool-definition rules, ping, an unknown method (-32601), one tools/call, GET on the endpoint (SSE or 405), and P50/P95 latency over pings. JSON and SSE answers are both read. Only a tool you name in test_tool_name, or one the server annotates readOnlyHint: true, is called — otherwise the call is skipped and not scored. Returns PASS/FIX/BLOCK with a 0-100 score and per-check details; INCONCLUSIVE (score null) when the server requires authorization, since no credentials are sent. A 301/302 on POST caps the verdict at FIX. The call runs from ia-qa.com: private and local addresses are refused, and stdio servers cannot be reached — for those, paste their tools/list answer into mcp_server_health_check. structuredContent is checked for presence, not validated against outputSchema.

test_tool_name.description: Tool to call in the tools/call step. Without it, the first tool annotated readOnlyHint: true is called, or none.

url.description: Public URL of the MCP endpoint (e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp). An origin alone (https://www.ia-qa.com) tries /mcp, then /.

name: mcp_server_evaluate
